sample_selection: producer fixed deterministic: top5 positive delta, top3 negative delta, smallest2 official counts; deduplicated
review_method: opened official primary XLS/MHT bytes directly and checked all ten exact cited settlement rows, literal count/sex cells, printed county header row, plus all ten underlying imported 2010 rows and pinned stage66 accepted UID roster; did not import producer scripts or load State

source_table_scope.Perm: XLS `01-04`, title explicitly includes municipal units, urban/rural settlement units and populated places; row2 says results of 2010 All-Russian census. Administrative rows and totals are not credited as NP records. 3699 classified proper NP rows; numeric NP values sum to official regional total 2635276 after excluding indent-4 inter-settlement administrative parents and retaining deeper physical-NP children; dash stays NULL.
source_table_scope.Prim: MHT embedded sheet001, census dated 14 Oct 2010 in title. Title explicitly includes municipal units and urban/rural populated places. 659 proper-NP rows; includes literal маяк/железнодорожный разъезд captions as proper NP types, with 11 numeric and 2 dash values. Sum of 648 numeric proper-NP values closes to regional 1956497; municipality/subtotal rows are not treated as NPs.

important_case: Малая Романова source row and official count cells pass; this sample has no post66 entity UID and is not in the accepted UID roster. It remains outside existing identity credit; this does not invalidate same-census population-source matching and does not prove a new node/identity.
name_rival_note: Красный Берег has a same-region different-type 2010 rural namesake (деревня, Кунгурский district) in the primary source inventory; the sampled поселок is uniquely typed and in Соликамский district. Thus typed-name and county binding are material. All other nine sampled literal official names/types each have one inventory row; 10-й км is normalized with hyphen separated.
limits: Fixed ten is a mechanism check, not a national accuracy estimate.
No source-only identity, coordinates, lifecycle, or population update was applied.
Perm date caption gives census-year results but not a printed as-of day; the exact 14 Oct date is explicitly printed in Prim MHT. Both are direct 2010 census publications.
